string.name: perm_internet
string.value: Used to fetch weather data from the Internet

string.name: perm_location
string.value: Used to get weather for your current location

string.name: perm_bg
string.value: Used to refresh weather in the background

string.name: privacy_flow_out_body
string.value: Only approximate coordinates (precise only if you grant it) are sent over HTTPS to your selected weather source for queries. No device ID, account, or advertising ID is attached.

string.name: privacy_flow_local_body
string.value: Weather results are cached locally (RDB) for offline viewing; locations and preferences are stored on device (RDB / Preferences).

string.name: privacy_flow_sync_body
string.value: When enabled, locations and settings sync across your HarmonyOS devices via Distributed KVStore; turn it off anytime in Settings.

string.name: privacy_flow_push_body
string.value: If you allow notifications, weather alerts may be delivered via Push Kit and the data provider; disable anytime in system settings.

string.name: privacy_flow_no_track_body
string.value: No account, no telemetry, no ads, no third-party analytics SDK. Nothing is uploaded beyond the weather queries above.

string.name: privacy_perm_internet_body
string.value: Required — fetches weather data from the selected source.

string.name: privacy_perm_location_body
string.value: Optional — requested only when you tap “Use Current Location”; coarse location is preferred and enough for city-level weather.

string.name: privacy_perm_notification_body
string.value: Optional — for the daily summary and alert reminders; authorized at runtime, declining only disables reminders.

string.name: privacy_third_openmeteo_body
string.value: Key-free global source; receives only your query coordinates and requires no account.

string.name: privacy_third_qweather_body
string.value: Requires an API Key stored only on this device in encrypted form. Off by default; enable it yourself in Settings and switch back anytime.

string.name: privacy_policy_collect_body
string.value: Only the minimum needed to show weather: approximate location (when authorized), the locations you add, and your preferences.

string.name: privacy_policy_storage_body
string.value: Data stays on your device. Delete locations or clear the cache anytime in Locations; uninstalling removes everything.

string.name: privacy_policy_rights_body
string.value: You can review, back up, and delete your data at any time; declining optional permissions only disables the related feature.

string.name: privacy_policy_minors_body
string.value: We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors.

string.name: privacy_policy_cross_border_body
string.value: Cities you add may be overseas; the default source covers the globe. Please also follow local privacy laws where you are.

string.name: privacy_policy_contact_body
string.value: Questions about privacy? Leave a message on the app store page; official contact details will be provided before release.

string.name: privacy_meta_note
string.value: Privacy notice v1.0 · Updated 2026-10 · Bundled in the app and readable offline; subject to legal review before release.
